This '''skirmish took place on Ranklinge''', in the city of [[Janusar]], when corrupt patroller [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Whisteer]] and his subordinates tried to squeeze money out of a [[Hand of Judgment|group]] of five [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] deserters. From a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] worker, [[Krinkins]] the stormtroopers learned how the corrupt [[Patroller Chief]] [[Cav'Saran]] and his subordinates had effectively taken over the entire city. Together with at least eight honest ex-patrollers, led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Atmino]], the stormtroopers took control of Patroller Central, killing Cav'Saran, Sergeant Whisteer, and five other corrupt patrollers in the process. After all of the corrupt patrollers had been dealt with, [[Daric LaRone]], leader of the stormtrooper group, left the city under Atmino's care and left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with his companions.
